messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Government, PIF, ESG and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear First Access Consulting Team,

Your Riyadh executive-search practice, including work with government, semi-government entities, PIF-related organisations and senior leadership mandates, makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing execution within a major multinational mining operation.

My profile is strongest where an organisation requires a senior leader who can connect institutional relationships, regulation, external stakeholders, reputation and execution. I have extensive experience coordinating with government agencies and regulators while supporting major investment, sustainability and operating priorities.

Saudi Arabia is my first international priority. I would welcome confidential consideration for Director, Senior Director, Country Director or Representative, Government Relations, External or Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across government-linked, PIF portfolio, industrial, infrastructure, energy and resources organisations.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

messages.subject: Saudi & UAE Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG and Strategic Country Leadership
messages.body:

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
